RE-STAMPED AFTER THE agromarin REBASE, NUMBER UNCHANGED. agromarin replayed onto origin on 2026-09-04, so every SHA in it changed and the stamps written earlier the same day were orphaned within the hour. Re-measured at c7964a30e in a clean detached worktree laid out beside a clean odoo worktree, as that lane lays it out, and it reads what the floor already said. This stamp names a agromarin commit, so an odoo rebase does not orphan it again.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMP REFRESHED, NUMBER UNCHANGED. The old stamp named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away, so --list flagged it ORPHANED-BASE and the sibling architecture.yml exited 2 asking to be re-measured rather than comparing. Re-measured in a clean detached worktree of agromarin at 8be3d637a, laid out beside a clean odoo worktree exactly as the lane does.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python odoo/tooling/architecture/py_x2many_count.py --addon agromarin --count -- and it reads 4, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does. A sibling floor's stamp is the SIBLING's commit, recorded through `--update --root agromarin` from a clean detached worktree of that checkout, so it resolves in the repository that was actually measured.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

8 -> 4, and all four units are named. approval left this repository for odoo/addons carrying exactly four hand-rolled counters, every one of them a search_count inside a loop: approval.dashboard._compute_user_metrics counted my_pending and my_urgent per record, and approval.delegate.wizard._compute_preview counted pending and waiting per record. All four were hoisted in the move -- the dashboard compute reads nothing but the environment, so its queries left the loop entirely, and the wizard's two became one _read_group over (user_id, state) indexed in memory. THE DEBT WAS PAID, NOT RELOCATED: py_x2many_count_addons is unchanged at 24, which is what says the four did not simply reappear under the new scope. The remaining four are remote_dav_sync's, untouched. Measured against the real tree because this gate is cross-repo and cannot run from a worktree -- sibling_repos_root() finds no agromarin beside a detached checkout; the concurrent marin/ edits contribute zero findings to this gate, so the reading is clean despite the dirty tree.
